record.one_liner: E-commerce platform (Magento, sold as Adobe Commerce) with REST and GraphQL APIs.
record.auth_notes: Cloud Service (SaaS) REST uses Adobe IMS OAuth 2. Self-hosted Magento Open Source / Adobe Commerce PaaS issue admin and customer tokens (username+password exchanged for a bearer token, api_key-like) and integration tokens that use OAuth 1.0a (other).
record.access_notes: critic: access paid_plan -> self_serve_free. Magento Open Source is free to install and the docs say Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source issue admin, customer and integration access tokens, so a developer can self-host and get working API credentials without paying. Adobe Commerce as a Cloud Service has a sandbox instance for design and testing (not confirmed free), but the free Open Source path is enough.
record.api_notes: critic: breadth moderate -> broad; REST covers catalog, orders, customers, carts, and GraphQL covers storefront. Cloud Service REST endpoints differ from PaaS/on-prem.
record.blocker_notes: critic: verdict blocked -> ready, main_blocker paid_plan -> none, because Magento Open Source gives a free self-hosted path to tokens. The official MCP is a developer-tooling server, not a store-data server; community MCP servers for store data exist.
